subject.title: fix(oc-path): bound config file reads with size cap

question: Should `oc-path` adopt an unconditional 10 MiB input limit for all existing resolve and set workflows, or should the extension preserve support for larger valid files while addressing accidental OOM paths differently?
rationale: Current behavior accepts these files, while the branch adds a permanent user-visible rejection threshold without shown documentation or compatibility evidence.

options.title: Adopt the cap with robust reads
options.body: Keep the 10 MiB product limit, but implement it against the opened file descriptor and document or test the intended rejection contract.

options.title: Preserve uncapped compatibility
options.body: Do not add a universal rejection threshold; pursue a different bounded-processing design only if it can retain existing supported large-file workflows.

recommendation.title: Adopt the cap with robust reads
recommendation.body: Keep the 10 MiB product limit, but implement it against the opened file descriptor and document or test the intended rejection contract.
